issues.detail: Fire Statement appears under Householder and Advertisement consent. Fire statements apply only to schemes with relevant high-rise residential buildings. The Householder excerpt is only legislation boilerplate, and the Advertisement consent excerpt is about the Location Plan.

When Required.'

summary: The Doncaster source PDFs could not be fetched, so the link's currency and the contents could not be verified against the source. Grokbot's own extract still shows clear errors: householder and prior-approval rows contradict their own exclusion text, many triggers are bare 'Requirement When Required.' headers or interleaved columns, and the data mixes the superseded August 2023 checklist with the 2025 list.
